camel_example: aliyun nas UpdateLifecyclePolicy --region cn-hangzhou --DeleteRules.1.Threshold 4 --StorageType InfrequentAccess --Description Lifecycle_policy_description --TransitRules.1.Threshold 3 --RetrieveRules.1.Attribute RetrieveType --LifecyclePolicyId 'lsp-bp1234567890ab0000' --RetrieveRules.1.Threshold All --TransitRules.1.Attribute Atime --FileSystemId 'bmcpfs-290w65p03ok64y00000' --DeleteRules.1.Attribute Atime --Paths.1 '/path1'
description_en:
Updates the rules of a lifecycle management policy. Only CPFS for Lingjun is supported.

UpdateLifecyclePolicy uses overwrite semantics. If an optional parameter is left empty, the corresponding field is deleted. To append lifecycle rules, first call the DescribeLifecyclePolicies operation to obtain the current lifecycle rule configurations, append the new lifecycle rule configurations, and then call the UpdateLifecyclePolicy operation to update the lifecycle rule configurations
description_zh:
更新一个生命周期管理策略的规则。仅智算 CPFS 支持。

UpdateLifecyclePolicy 是覆盖语义，非必选参数为空则表示删除对应字段。当您需要追加生命周期规则时，请先调用 DescribeLifecyclePolicies 接口获取当前生命周期规则配置，然后追加新的生命周期规则配置，最后调用 UpdateLifecyclePolicy 接口更新生命周期规则配置
kebab_example: aliyun nas update-lifecycle-policy --file-system-id bmcpfs-290w65p03ok64y00000 --storage-type InfrequentAccess --lifecycle-policy-id lsp-bp1234567890ab0000 --description Lifecycle_policy_description --paths /path1 --transit-rules Attribute=Atime Threshold=3 --retrieve-rules Attribute=RetrieveType Threshold=All --delete-rules Attribute=Atime Threshold=4 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateLifecyclePolicy

parameters.help_en:
The file system ID. The ID starts with bmcpfs-, such as bmcpfs-290w65p03ok64ya****.
This parameter is supported only when LifecyclePolicyType is set to OnDemand in the lifecycle management policy of a CPFS for Lingjun file system
parameters.help_zh:
文件系统ID。以bmcpfs-开头，如bmcpfs-290w65p03ok64ya****。
仅 CPFS 智算版文件系统的生命周期管理策略中 LifecyclePolicyType 为 OnDemand 时支持
parameters.name: file_system_id

parameters.help_en:
The tiered storage type.

Valid values:
InfrequentAccess: IA storage class. This is the default value.
Archive: Archive storage
parameters.help_zh:
分级存储类型。
InfrequentAccess：低频存储（默认值）。
Archive：归档存储
parameters.name: storage_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the lifecycle policy.
This parameter is required for CPFS for Lingjun file systems
parameters.help_zh:
生命周期策略的 ID。
CPFS 智算版 文件系统必填
parameters.name: lifecycle_policy_id

parameters.help_en:
The description of the lifecycle policy.

Format:
The description must be 3 to 64 characters in length, start with a letter, and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), or hyphens (-).
Only CPFS for Lingjun is supported
parameters.help_zh:
生命周期策略描述。

格式：
长度为3-64个字符，必须以字母开头，可以包含英文字母、数字、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）。
仅 CPFS 智算版支持
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The absolute paths of the directories associated with the lifecycle management policy
parameters.help_zh: 生命周期管理策略关联目录的绝对路径
parameters.name: paths

element_fields.help_en:
The attribute of the rule.

Valid values:
Atime: the access time of the file
element_fields.help_zh:
规则的属性。

取值：
Atime: 文件的访问时间
element_fields.name: attribute

element_fields.help_en:
The threshold of the rule.

Valid values:
If Attribute is set to Atime, the value specifies the number of days since the file was last accessed. Valid values: 1 to 365
element_fields.help_zh:
规则的阈值。

取值：
当 Attribute 为 Atime 时，表示多少天未访问的文件，取值范围[1,365]
element_fields.name: threshold

parameters.help_en:
The file data transit rules. You can configure up to one rule.

This parameter is supported only when LifecyclePolicyType is set to Auto for a CPFS for Lingjun file system
parameters.help_zh:
文件数据转储规则，最多配置 1 个。

仅 CPFS 智算版文件系统的 LifecyclePolicyType=Auto 时支持
parameters.name: transit_rules

element_fields.help_en:
The attribute of the rule.

Valid values:
RetrieveType: the retrieval method
element_fields.help_zh:
规则的属性，取值：
RetrieveType:  取回方式
element_fields.name: attribute

element_fields.help_en:
The threshold of the rule.

Valid values:
RetrieveType
    - AfterVisit: supported when LifecyclePolicyType is set to Auto. Indicates best-effort recall on visit.
    - All: supported when LifecyclePolicyType is set to OnDemand. Indicates retrieval of all data
element_fields.help_zh:
规则的阈值，取值：
RetrieveType
    - AfterVisit： LifecyclePolicyType=Auto 支持，代表尽力 recall on visit
    - All:  LifecyclePolicyType=OnDemand 支持，代表取回所有
element_fields.name: threshold

parameters.help_en:
The file data retrieval rules. You can configure up to one rule.
Only CPFS for Lingjun file systems are supported
parameters.help_zh:
文件数据取回规则，最多配置 1 个。
仅 CPFS 智算版文件系统支持
parameters.name: retrieve_rules

element_fields.help_en:
The attribute of the rule.

Atime: the access time of the file
element_fields.help_zh:
规则的属性。

取值：
Atime: 文件的访问时间
element_fields.name: attribute

element_fields.help_en:
The threshold of the rule.

Valid values:
If Attribute is set to Atime, the value specifies the number of days since the file was last accessed. Valid values: 1 to 365
element_fields.help_zh:
规则的阈值。

取值：
当 Attribute 为 Atime 时，表示多少天未访问的文件，取值范围[1,365]
element_fields.name: threshold

parameters.help_en: The file data expiration and deletion rules
parameters.help_zh: 文件数据过期删除规则
parameters.name: delete_rules
